summary: All four ATHZ items were tested with read-only requests on http://shop.lab.test (recon origins were empty; the HTTPS probe was refused by the gateway, so HTTP was used). Results: (1) WSTG-ATHZ-01 traversal/file inclusion: not observed on /static/, /products?id= or /search.php?q=. (2) WSTG-ATHZ-02 authorization bypass: /admin/ enforces roles and the header bypass attempts failed, but the admin API /api/v1/admin/users returns the full user list to a customer account; lead recorded (high). (3) WSTG-ATHZ-03 privilege escalation: the customer (alice) reads admin data (read-only; write-side escalation not tested since writes are disabled); same lead. (4) WSTG-ATHZ-04 IDOR: alice reads carol's order 1002 including shipping address via /api/v1/orders/{id}; anonymous access is blocked; lead recorded (high). Leads also recorded for other lanes: /backup/ returns 200 anonymously and is listed in robots.txt (medium), and app.js includes a client-side Stripe publishable key and a redacted AWS key id. Limits: recon provided no endpoint list, so coverage came from the HTML links and the JS bundle only; the /api/v1 catch-all returning {"ok":true} made object-ID enumeration on users/cart/items inconclusive; no write requests were sent.
